versions.changelog:
v1.0.1 patch — clarify scope of '≤2 parallel sub-agents' rule.
- Description and Why-section now make explicit: ≤2 is the cap for long-form writing tasks (where output coherence and shared file regions matter)
- For non-writing agentic tasks with independent outputs, the cap can be relaxed to ≤4 (see trinity-harness)
- No actual rule change for writing workflows; this is a documentation clarification to avoid confusion with general-purpose harness skills.

Initial release. Rigorous workflow for long-form knowledge content (textbooks/knowledge bases/deep reports) with 8 iron rules, 9-step standard workflow, and machine-verification scripts. Distilled from 4 battle-tested projects (multi-chapter AI/ML textbook, tactical gear KB, supplements KB, product design docs).
